community_text:
[Rating: 1/10] So the first comparison is Scout, without the restrictions, because you take a card from the set you beat. And that's kind of it! Is this meant for children? I can't imagine any kids who would enjoy this very much.  Much like Hachi Train, there's many turns where you sit there passing, doing literally nothing, while watching the others play a light game. This is one of the reasons I liked Nanatoridori slightly better (everyone's constantly drawing cards), but at least Hachi Train had some rising stakes as the round progresses, and the pressure of being the last one with cards. Here, the stakes

[Rating: 1/10] Absolutely blows my mind how such a modern game from 2024 got promoted, even rewarded by an As d'Or in 2025, so badly explained in text reviews, and even exists, when it's absolutely junk. Tried really hard to push forward to see if something was missed, but nothing could save it : my mouth dropped, and continued to drop, by how random, boring and pointless it was. This thing is not a game, it's beyond garbage.

[Rating: 1/10] The description on the packet has nothing to do with gameplay. This has nothing to do with Vikings, Odin or "sending your warriors into battle"

[Rating: 3/10] Super disappointed with this game. I bought it because I saw people calling it “ scout killer” but not even close. This game has almost no strategy. If you a player is forced to skip because they dont have a higher hand then that person is basically screwed. You will keep on having to skip almost every time until the round is over. I can see why people compare it to scout because of some similarities but this game so dull and boring. My game group does not want to play this again.

[Rating: 3/10] The card play was kind of fun but when half of your turns are just passing, it starts to feel like less and less like an actual game.

[Rating: 3/10] Local boardgame store loved the game, kept pushing it so I bought it. I tried really hard to like the game. At the end of the day, I don't have fun playing. Won't stay in my collection.
